newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-GANGULY THE BEST IN INDIA WARM-UP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GANGULY THE BEST IN INDIA WARM-UP.

text.p: Saurav Ganguly made the top score of 79 on a turning pitch on the opening day of India's three-day game against the Sri Lanka Board President's XI on Tuesday.
India reached 295 for nine, with openers Gagan Khoda and Navjot Sidhu also completing half-centuries.
The Indian batsmen, seeking practice ahead of Saturday's start to the first test, made slow progress in the morning session with Khoda and Sidhu adding just 87.
The pair extended their partnership to 136 when Khoda was caught and bowled by skipper Ruwan Kalpage for 59.
Rahul Dravid lasted just four balls before he was also caught and bowled for nought, this time by leg-spinner Upul Chandana who took four for 83.
Sidhu made 64 in 213 minutes with one six and nine fours and skipper Sachin Tendulkar hit 32 before both fell to catches in the deep.
Ganguly struck a six and 11 fours before he was eighth out with India on 290.
